articles.title: More Mainland Visitors Than Expected Came to Hong Kong During Golden Week Holiday
articles.summary: Hong Kong welcomed more visitors from mainland China than officials had predicted during the National Day Golden Week holiday. By the sixth day of the seven-day break, the number of mainland arrivals had already reached 1.3 million — beating the government's full-week forecast of 1.29 million. That figure was also about 11.6 per cent higher than the same period last year. Shopping malls and hotels across the city reported busy trade throughout the holiday. The strong visitor numbers show that Hong Kong remains a popular travel destination for mainland tourists, especially during major public holidays.

lv1: How many mainland Chinese visitors came to Hong Kong during Golden Week? (在黃金週期間，有多少名內地遊客來到香港？)
Did the number of visitors go up or down compared to last year? (與去年相比，訪客數目是增加還是減少？)
lv2: Why do you think so many mainland visitors chose to come to Hong Kong during Golden Week? (你認為為甚麼這麼多內地遊客選擇在黃金週期間來香港？)
How might a large number of tourists affect the daily lives of people who live in Hong Kong? (大量遊客會如何影響香港居民的日常生活？)
lv3: Some Hong Kong residents feel that too many tourists can cause problems such as crowding and rising prices. Do you think Hong Kong should set a limit on visitor numbers? Give reasons for your answer. (部分香港市民認為遊客過多會引致擠迫和物價上漲等問題。你認為香港應否設定遊客人數上限？請說明理由。)

Hong Kong relies heavily on tourism from mainland China. What are the advantages and disadvantages of depending on one main source of visitors for the city's economy? (香港在很大程度上依賴內地旅客。過度依賴單一主要客源對城市經濟有甚麼優點和缺點？)

articles.title: Hong Kong Named World's Freest Economy for Another Year
articles.summary: Hong Kong has once again been ranked as the most economically free city in the world, according to the Fraser Institute, a well-known research organisation. Economic freedom means people and businesses can make their own choices about buying, selling, and working with fewer government restrictions. Hong Kong has held this top position for many years. At the same time, finance ministers from APEC member countries are preparing to meet in Hong Kong to discuss trade and economic cooperation across the Asia-Pacific region. These two events together highlight Hong Kong's continued importance as a global financial and business centre.

lv1: Which organisation said Hong Kong is the world's freest economy? (哪個機構表示香港是全球最自由的經濟體？)
What does 'economic freedom' mean in simple terms? (「經濟自由」簡單來說是甚麼意思？)
lv2: Why is it important for a city to be seen as economically free? How might this help attract businesses and people to Hong Kong? (為甚麼一個城市被視為經濟自由是重要的？這對吸引企業和人才來港有何幫助？)
What kinds of topics do you think finance ministers from different countries would discuss when they meet in Hong Kong? (你認為來自不同國家的財政部長在香港開會時，會討論哪類議題？)
lv3: Some people argue that economic freedom benefits businesses more than ordinary citizens. Do you agree? Who gains the most from a free economy, and who might be left behind? (有人認為經濟自由對企業的好處多於普通市民。你同意嗎？誰從自由經濟中獲益最多，誰又可能被遺忘？)

Hong Kong faces increasing competition from cities like Singapore and Dubai as financial hubs. What should Hong Kong do to maintain its leading position in the global economy? (香港在全球金融中心地位上面臨來自新加坡、杜拜等城市的競爭。香港應如何維持其領先地位？)

articles.title: Google首次將AI晶片送上太空 測試「軌道數據中心」可行性
articles.summary: 科技巨頭Google近日完成一項重大突破，首次將人工智能（AI）晶片——張量處理器（TPU）送上太空，目的是測試在地球軌道上建立「數據中心」的可行性。這種「軌道數據中心」若能成功運作，便可在太空中處理大量數據，有望解決地球上電力供應不足的問題。隨著AI技術迅速發展，全球數據中心的耗電量急劇上升，科學家正積極尋找創新方案，而太空數據中心或許是未來的其中一個答案。

lv1: Google今次把哪種晶片送上太空？
「軌道數據中心」是設在哪裡的？
lv2: 為甚麼科學家要考慮在太空建立數據中心，而不是繼續在地球上建造？
AI技術的快速發展對地球的電力資源帶來甚麼影響？
lv3: 在太空建立數據中心可能帶來哪些好處和風險？你認為這個方向值得大力投資嗎？請說明理由。
科技公司不斷將業務擴展至太空，這對全球太空資源的分配和管理有甚麼影響？各國應如何合作訂立規則？

articles.title: 杭港攜手發展低空經濟 香港科技園與杭州企業簽署合作協議
articles.summary: 香港科技園公司與杭州實業集團近日簽署戰略合作備忘錄，雙方將共同推動商業航天及低空經濟的發展。「低空經濟」是指在低空範圍內進行的各類飛行活動，例如無人機送貨及空中的士等新興產業。特區政府在最新一份《施政報告》中，已將低空經濟列為香港的重點發展方向之一。今次港杭合作，標誌著兩地在創新科技領域的聯繫進一步加強，有望為香港帶來更多新興產業機遇。

lv1: 香港科技園今次與哪個城市的機構簽署合作協議？
「低空經濟」包括哪些你認識的飛行活動？
lv2: 為甚麼香港政府要把低空經濟列為重點發展方向？這對香港的未來有甚麼好處？
香港與內地城市合作發展創新科技，對兩地分別有甚麼得益？
lv3: 無人機和空中的士等低空飛行器在城市廣泛應用，可能帶來哪些社會問題，例如私隱、噪音或安全等方面？政府應如何制定相關法規？
有意見認為香港應加大力度發展創新科技，以減少對金融和旅遊業的依賴。你認同嗎？多元化發展對香港的長遠競爭力有何影響？
